fields.h1: Engeri y’Okubuulira Abalala ku Kukkiriza Kwo
fields.meta_title: Engeri y’Okubuulira ku Kukkiriza Kwo (Awatali Kutya)
fields.description: Okubuulira enjiri ssanyu lya buli mukkiriza, so si mulimu gwa bakugu bokka. Wano tulaba engeri y’okubuulira abalala ku kukkiriza kwo mu ngeri ennyangu — ng’oyita mu bulamu obukyuse, mu bujulirwa bwo, ne mu mawulire amalungi aga Yesu.
fields.body_html:
Eri Abakristaayo bangi, bitono ebitiisa ng’okubuulira abalala ku kukkiriza kwabwe. Tukkiriza nti enjiri ge mawulire agasinga obulungi mu nsi yonna, naye okulowooza obulowooza ku kugabuulira omuntu kiyinza okutusannyalaza — nga tutya okwogera ekikyamu, okugaanibwa, oba obutamanya kimala. Naye okubuulira enjiri si kuyitibwa kwa njawulo okw’abakugu abatono abalina ebirabo; kye kitiibwa eky’essanyu ekya buli mukkiriza. Ekiragiro kya Yesu ekyasembayo eri abagoberezi be kyali kya kugenda kufuula abantu b’amawanga gonna abayigirizwa (Matayo 28:19), era n’abasuubiza amaanyi ag’okukikola. Okubuulira ku kukkiriza kwo kwe kuba nti omwavu omu abuulira munne omwavu gy’ayinza okusanga emmere. Wano tulaba engeri y’okukikola mu ngeri ennyangu, n’obwesigwa, era awatali kutya.

Jjukira nti Katonda y’alokola, so si ggwe

Omugugu ogusinga obunene guvaawo ku ffe mu kaseera ke tujjukira nti omulimu guno gwa ani. Tetulokola muntu n’omu; Katonda y’alokola. Omulimu gwaffe kwe kuba abajulirwa — okusonga ku Kristo — n’okuleka ebivaamu mu mikono gye. Kino kitusumulula nnyo. Tekikwetaagisa kuba mugezi nnyo okusobola okuwakana n’omuntu okutuusa lw’ayingira mu bwakabaka, wadde okuba omwogezi omukugu okusobola okumegga buli kiwakanyizo. Kikwetaagisa kubuulira bubuulizi ky’omanyi, n’okwesiga Omwoyo okukola ekyo ye yekka ky’asobola okukola.

Enjiri yennyini y’erina amaanyi, so si bukugu bwa mubaka. Pawulo yagamba nti, “Enjiri tenkwasa nsonyi: kubanga ge maanyi ga Katonda agalokola buli muntu akkiriza” (Abaruumi 1:16). Obubaka ye bbomu; ffe tukutte bukutte kakunta ka kibiriiti. Era Yesu yasuubiza amaanyi gennyini ge tutalina: “muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8). Tuwa obujulirwa mu maanyi ge, so si mu gaffe — ekitegeeza nti obunafu bwaffe tebulina kutuziyiza.

Beera n’obulamu obuleetera abantu okwebuuza

Emirundi mingi, ekisinga okukakasa abantu ku njiri bwe bulamu obukyuse. Abantu nga tebannawuliriza bigambo byaffe, batera okusooka okutunuulira obulamu bwaffe, era obulamu obujjudde okwagala, obwesimbu, essanyu n’emirembe buleeta ebibuuzo byennyini bye twagala ennyo okuddamu. Yesu yagamba nti, “ebikolwa byammwe ebirungi byakirenga abantu bonna, babirabenga, bagulumize Kitammwe ali mu ggulu.” (Matayo 5:16). Obulamu obusikiriza buleetera abantu okuwuliriza, ekintu ebigambo ebigezi byokka kye bitasobola kukola.

Peetero alowooza ku kakwate kano bw’agamba abakkiriza nti, “Mutyenga Mukama waffe Kristo mu mitima gyammwe. Era bulijjo mubenga beetegefu okuddamu buli ababuuza okunnyonnyola essuubi lyammwe” (1 Peetero 3:15). Weetegereze embeera: omuntu abuuza, kubanga alabye essuubi erisaanira okubuuzibwako. Kale beera mu ngeri eyo abantu ne beebuuza ekikufuula ow’enjawulo — omugumiikiriza mu buzibu, omugabi, eyanguwa okusonyiwa, atakankanyizibwa bizibu — era emikisa gyo emirungi egy’okwogera mingi gijja kujja ng’okuddamu ebibuuzo obulamu bwo bye bureese.

Buulira emboozi yo

Oyinza okuwulira nti tomanyi kimala ku by’enzikiriza okusobola okubuulira ku kukkiriza kwo, naye waliwo ensonga emu gy’osinga okumanya okusinga omuntu yenna mu nsi: Katonda ky’akoze mu bulamu bwo. Obujulirwa bwo kye kimu ku bikozesebwa ebisinga amaanyi by’olina, kubanga tewali ayinza kuwakanya by’oyiseemu. Yesu bwe yawonya omusajja, yamugamba bugambi nti, “Ddayo ewammwe mu bantu bo obabuulire ebintu byonna Mukama by’akukoledde era nga bw’akusaasidde.” (Makko 5:19) — era obujulirwa obwo bwalina obuzito.

Kale yiga okubuulira emboozi yo mu ngeri ennyangu: obulamu bwo bwali butya nga tonnamanya Kristo, wajja otya gy’ali, era enjawulo ki gy’akoze. Tekyetaagisa kuba kya kwewuunyisa okusobola okuba eky’amazima era ekikwata ku mutima. Omusajja eyazaalibwa nga muzibe w’amaaso, ng’anyigirizibwa abakugu abaali bamukyawa, teyeetaaga kuwakana kwa maanyi — “kye mmanyi kiri kimu nti nnali muzibe w’amaaso, naye kaakano ndaba” (Yokaana 9:25). Naawe osobola okukola bw’otyo. Yogera mu bwesimbu ku Mulokozi gw’ozudde, era leka okwebaza kwo kulabike. Omujulirwa eyeebaza akwata ku mitima. Era kiyamba okulowooza ku mboozi yo nga bukyali, omukisa bwe gujja obe nga weetegefu okugibuulira mu ngeri ennyangu era n’ebbugumu, mu dakiika ntono ez’amazima, nga towuubaala wadde okubuulira ng’ali ku kituuti. Tozannya muzannyo; obuulira mukwano gwo ekintu ekisinga obulungi ekyali kikutuseeko.

Songa abantu eri Yesu n’enjiri ye

Wadde obulamu bwaffe n’emboozi zaffe biggulawo enzigi, ku kiseera ekimu abantu beetaaga okuwulira amawulire amalungi gennyini — nti Katonda abaagala, nti ekibi kyabwe kibaawula ku ye, nti Yesu yafa n’azuukira okubalokola, era nti basobola okusonyiyibwa n’okufuulibwa abaggya nga bakyukira gy’ali mu kukkiriza. Okukkiriza kujja lwa kuwulira obubaka buno: “Era balikkiriza batya oyo gwe batawulirangako? Era baliwulira batya awatali abuulira?” (Abaruumi 10:14). Waliwo ateekwa okubabuulira, era Katonda asiima okukozesa abakkiriza aba bulijjo okukikola.

Firipo bwe yasisinkana omugenyi eyali anoonya ng’asoma Ebyawandiikibwa, “n’amubuulira Enjiri ya Yesu Kristo.” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 8:35) — yasigala ng’essira aliteeka ku Kristo. “ku bwa Kristo tuli babaka, era Katonda atuma ffe okwogera nammwe. Kyetuva tubeegayirira, ku bwa Kristo, mutabagane ne Katonda.”, era Katonda ayita mu ffe okwegayirira nti: “mutabagane ne Katonda.” (2 Abakkolinso 5:20). Yiga okunnyonnyola enjiri mu ngeri ennyangu, era obeere mwetegefu, n’ekisa, okuyita omuntu okuddamu — okwenenya n’okwesiga Yesu. Tomukaka; omuwa ekirabo ekisinga byonna omuntu ky’ayinza okufuna.

Beera muwombeefu, owa ekitiibwa, era ow’amagezi

Okubuulira ku kukkiriza kwaffe tekikwata ku kuwangula nkaayana oba okusiba abantu mu nsonda; kikwata ku kubaagala okutuusa lwe batuuka eri Kristo. Peetero agamba nti, “muddengamu n’obuwombeefu, awamu n’eggonjebwa” (1 Peetero 3:15), era Pawulo abuulirira nti: “Abo abatannakkiriza mutambulenga nabo n’amagezi, nga mukozesa bulungi ebiseera bye mulina. Enjogera yammwe ebeerenga ya kisa, era ng’enoga omunnyo” (Abakkolosaayi 4:5-6). Obuwombeefu, ekitiibwa n’ekisa biggulawo emitima obukambwe gye buggalawo obuggazi.

Kino kitegeeza okuwuliriza era n’okwogera, okussa ekitiibwa mu bibuuzo by’abantu mu kifo ky’okubirinnyirira, n’okugumiikiriza ekkubo eritera okutwala ekiseera. Batono abakyuka mu kunyumya okumu kwokka; emirundi mingi Katonda akozesa okusisinkana okutono okungi, era oboolyawo ffe ne tusiga, omulala n’afukirira, Katonda n’akuza. Kale topima buwanguzi na bivaamu mu kaseera ako. Beera mwesigwa, beera wa kisa, era ebivaamu obirekere Katonda, ye yekka aggulawo emitima.

Okwolekera okutya okugaanibwa

Ekiziyiza ekisinga obunene mu kubuulira ku kukkiriza kwaffe kwe kutya — okutya okugaanibwa, okuswala, oba okufiirwa omukwano. Okutya kuno kwa ddala, naye tekulina kutufuga. Ebyawandiikibwa bikutuuma erinnya era ne bikuddamu: “Kubanga Mwoyo wa Katonda, gwe yatuwa tatufuula bati, wabula atuwa amaanyi, n’okwagala era n’okwegendereza” (2 Timoseewo 1:7). Obutiitiizi bwe tuwulira tebuva eri Katonda, era Omwoyo oyo yennyini atujjuza amaanyi asobola okutunyweza nga tufubutuka okukola.

Kiyamba okujjukira nti okutya abantu kye banaalowooza mutego: “Okutya omuntu kuleeta ekyambika, naye buli eyeesiga Mukama anaabanga mirembe” (Engero 29:25). Tuvunaanibwa Katonda, so si ndowooza z’abalala, era okusiima kwe kutusumulula okuva mu bufuzi obw’ekyejo obw’endowooza zaabwe. Ekkanisa eyasooka bwe yayolekera obukyayi obwa ddala, teyasaba kabi kaggyibwewo wabula yasaba obuvumu okweyongera okwogera: “owe abaddu bo obuvumu babuulire ekigambo kyo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:29) — era Katonda n’anyeenya ekifo, n’abajjuza buggya. Saba essaala eyo yennyini. Okugaanibwa, bwe kujja, si nkomerero ya nsi, era kututeeka mu kibinja ekirungi; abantu baagaana ne Mukama yennyini. Saba Katonda akuwe obuvumu, kwata eddaala ettono, era emirundi mingi ojja kusanga nti okutya kukendeera ng’okikola.

Tandikira w’oli, ku b’omanyi

Otandika otya? Si kutongoza kawefube munene, wabula kusabira n’okutuukirira abantu abali okumpi naawe edda — ab’omu maka go, mikwano gyo, baliraanwa bo, ab’okola nabo. Andereya bwe yasisinkana Yesu, “n’agenda anoonya muganda we Simooni n’amugamba nti, ‘Tulabye Masiya’” (Yokaana 1:41), n’amuleeta eri Kristo. Firipo bwe yasanga Nassanayiri, Nassanayiri n’awakanya nti, “Mu Nazaaleesi musobola okuvaamu ekintu ekirungi?” Firipo teyawakana naye; yamugamba bugambi nti, “Jjangu weerabireko.” (Yokaana 1:46). Emirundi mingi okuyita okusinga obulungi kwe kwo kwennyini — jjangu weerabireko wekka.

Kale saba olw’abantu batono ng’obayita amannya, saba Katonda akuwe emikisa n’obuvumu, era okwate amadaala amatono g’akuggulirawo: okubayita mu kkanisa, okulya nabo ekijjulo, okunyumya nabo mu bwesimbu, ekitabo ekiddamu ebibuuzo byabwe, emboozi yo ng’ogibuulira n’ebbugumu. Tojja kukikola mu ngeri etuukiridde, era tekikwetaagisa; Katonda akozesa abajulirwa aba bulijjo abatatuukiridde. Ekiragiro kijjira wamu n’ekisuubizo — “Ndi nammwe bulijjo n’okutuukira ddala ensi lw’eriggwaawo” (Matayo 28:20). Tobuulira ku kukkiriza kwo ng’oli wekka. Fubutuka, yogera, era weesige Mukama w’amakungula okukola ebisigaddeyo. Tewali kitiibwa kisinga ku nsi kuno ng’okuba oyo asonga munne gw’atambula naye mu lugendo eri Emmere ey’Obulamu — era ssanyu litono erisinga obuziba ng’okulaba omuntu gw’oyagala ng’ava mu kizikiza ng’ayingira mu kitangaala kubanga ggwe wali mwetegefu, ne bw’oba ng’okankana, okwasamya akamwa ko.

qa.question: Obuulira otya omuntu ku kukkiriza kwo?
qa.answer: Beera n’obulamu obuleetera abantu okwebuuza, bategeeze emboozi yo ku ekyo Katonda ky’akukoledde, era osonge abantu eri Yesu n’eri amawulire amalungi. Kikole “n’obuwombeefu, awamu n’eggonjebwa” (1 Peetero 3:15). Okubuulira ku kukkiriza kwo si mulimu gwa bakugu; kwe kuba nti omwavu omu abuulira munne omwavu gy’ayinza okusanga emmere.

qa.question: Ate bwe mba nga simanyi kimala okubuulira ku kukkiriza kwange?
qa.answer: Jjukira nti Katonda y’alokola, so si ggwe. Omulimu gwo kwe kuba omujulirwa n’okusonga ku Kristo, olwo ebivaamu n’obirekera ye. Enjiri yennyini y’erina amaanyi: “ge maanyi ga Katonda agalokola buli muntu akkiriza” (Abaruumi 1:16). Era waliwo ensonga emu gy’osinga okumanya okusinga omuntu yenna: Katonda ky’akoze mu bulamu bwo.

qa.question: Mbuulira ntya obujulirwa bwange?
qa.answer: Nnyonnyola emboozi yo mu ngeri ennyangu: obulamu bwo bwali butya nga tonnamanya Kristo, wajja otya gy’ali, era enjawulo ki gy’akoze. Tekyetaagisa kuba kya kwewuunyisa okusobola okuba eky’amazima. Omusajja eyazaalibwa nga muzibe w’amaaso yagamba bugambi nti, “kye mmanyi kiri kimu nti nnali muzibe w’amaaso, naye kaakano ndaba” (Yokaana 9:25). Kirowoozeeko nga bukyali osobole okukibuulira n’ebbugumu mu dakiika ntono ez’amazima.

qa.question: Mpangula ntya okutya okubuulira enjiri?
qa.answer: Okutya kuno kwa ddala, naye “Kubanga Mwoyo wa Katonda, gwe yatuwa tatufuula bati, wabula atuwa amaanyi, n’okwagala era n’okwegendereza” (2 Timoseewo 1:7), era “Okutya omuntu kuleeta ekyambika” (Engero 29:25). Ekkanisa eyasooka, bwe yali eyolekedde obukyayi, teyasaba kukuumibwa wabula yasaba obuvumu (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:29). Saba essaala eyo, kwata eddaala ettono, era emirundi mingi okutya kukendeera ng’okikola.

qa.question: Ani gwe nsaanye okusooka okubuulira ku kukkiriza kwange?
qa.answer: Tandikira ku bantu abali okumpi naawe: ab’omu maka go, mikwano gyo, baliraanwa bo ne b’okola nabo. Andereya bwe yasisinkana Yesu, “n’agenda anoonya muganda we Simooni n’amugamba nti, ‘Tulabye Masiya’” (Yokaana 1:41). Nassanayiri bwe yawakanya nti, “Mu Nazaaleesi musobola okuvaamu ekintu ekirungi?” Firipo yamuddamu bugambi nti, “Jjangu weerabireko.” (Yokaana 1:46). Saba olw’abantu batono ng’obayita amannya, era okwate amadaala amatono Katonda g’akuggulirawo, gamba ng’okubayita oba okunyumya nabo mu bwesimbu.
